class.name: SceneModelRenderingBackend
class.brief_description: Godot's scenes as models of [ModelRenderingServer], the backend [code]"scene"[/code].
class.description: A model is a [PackedScene] by its path (a [code].tscn[/code], a [code].scn[/code], an imported [code].glb[/code]), a part is a node of it by its name. An instance draws the scene's meshes with [RenderingServer] instances ([constant ModelRenderingServer.INSTANCER_OPTIMIZED]) or as the scene's own nodes under the attached node ([constant ModelRenderingServer.INSTANCER_NODES]); a streamed placement is built while the camera is in its range ([SceneryStreamingServer]). Its models have no lights, no skins and no materials read ahead: [method ModelRenderingBackend.instance_has_light] is false for every one, a signal head attached draws nothing and goes with the instance. It is the core's own renderer, registered as the core starts.
